items.title: Studio tour: how the autoplay hero video was shot
items.body:
## Transcript

**Host:** Thanks for having us in the studio.

**Creator:** We shot the autoplay hero video in one afternoon, with natural light from the north windows. The loop is eight seconds, muted, and it starts on the product, not on a face.

**Host:** Why muted?

**Creator:** Browsers only autoplay muted video, and people scroll past anything that waits for a click.
items.author: sample.creator

items.title: Q&A: packaging and shipping
items.body:
## Transcript

**Creator:** The new boxes are recyclable and ship flat. We switched suppliers in the spring, and returns dropped because the inserts hold the bottle in place.
